title: Marketplace catalog
description:
JSON Schema for the marketplace.json file at the root of a plugin repository — the catalog that LinkDesk reads when the user adds your repository as a marketplace source. Publish (`linkdesk-plugin-sdk publish`) maintains this file for you via the GitHub Contents API (read sha → merge entry → PUT); hand-editing is for review/setup only. Field set mirrors the TS contract `CatalogPluginEntry` / `MarketplaceCatalog` in @linkdesk/plugin-sdk (spec §三/§3.2) — the code is the single source of truth; missing fields never crash the publisher (entries merge additively).

Marketplace-Store v2 extensions (2026-11, all optional — old flat catalogs stay valid): root-level `sources` (officially reviewed third-party sources), `collections` (curated lists) and `categoryRail` (category display order); entry-level `pricing` / `screenshots` (video first item) / `authorId`. The shapes of the two sibling files that complete a v2 source folder are defined here as `$defs` too: `authors/<authorId>.json` → `$defs.authorBlock`, `vendors.json` → an array of `$defs.vendor`. The publisher never writes those files; they are maintained by their owners (author / catalog operator).

$schema.description: JSON Schema $schema reference (e.g. the marketplace-kit schema URL). Legal here so the file validates against the schema it names — `marketplace-kit init` writes this line and VS Code uses it for completion/red squiggles; the store parse ignores it.

version.description: Catalog format version. Written by the publisher; keep whatever is already there.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last publish. Written by the publisher.

plugins.description: One entry per plugin in this repository. The publisher upserts by `id`: new id appends, existing id merges (your new version/history in, description/icon falling back to previous values). Root-level fields other than version/updatedAt (sources, collections, categoryRail) are carried through untouched by the publisher — they are not the publisher's to manage.

sources.description: Officially reviewed third-party marketplace sources (official catalog root only — only the catalog operator may write it). Endorsement, not a copy: the store auto-merges these sources, entries stay in the author's own repo. Merge order: official → this list → user-added; same id → highest semver wins. A PR may only add/remove the author's own line; CI validates reachability and id collisions.

oneOf.description: Folder reference: the full declaration lives at collections/<id>.json next to this file (split form, R4-4.5). The store fetches the referenced file only for ids listed here — plain v1 catalogs declare zero references and trigger zero extra fetches.

collections.description: Curated collection declarations — stable-id lists of pluginIds rendered as a collection slot (banner/strip/duo/grid map to card variants). May be declared here (any repo's marketplace.json) — the recommended home. Two read forms: inline objects (declared here) or string ids referencing collections/<id>.json (split form — `marketplace-kit` publish maintains both). Members reference entries by id; missing ids are skipped silently (defensive, same as catalog merge). Titles are author data shown as-is (no t() pipeline).

categoryRail.description: Category rail display order for this source. Slugs not registered in the marketplace's value table fall into the Other bucket (never dropped, never an error).

id.description: Plugin identity (plugin.json `pluginId`) — dedup key for the whole catalog. Immutable once published.

name.description: Display name shown in the marketplace list.

version.description: Latest published version (mirrors versions[0].version — kept for backward compatibility with old catalog entries).

description.description: Short description shown in the marketplace list.

authorId.description: Marketplace-Store v2 author identity key — links this entry to an `authors/<authorId>.json` author block and to the vendor registry (`vendors.json`): a registry hit is what turns the verified/official badge on; no hit → community badge. Recommended value: the author's GitHub username (identity canon). Never trust a display name for this — names are not identities.

icon.description: Small UI icon of the installed plugin. Published as a remote raw URL (raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/v<version>/…): uninstalled users' clients fetch it from here. Note: the icon bar force-tints this image, so a coloured picture turns into a blob — that is what marketIcon is for (the three-image model is documented in the authoring guide).

iconSource.description: Where the icon value came from (publisher bookkeeping).

marketIcon.description: Coloured identity image for marketplace display (Type-2 of the three-image model) — the marketplace row reads this one, not the tinted icon-bar silhouette. Remote raw URL, same shape as icon.

marketIconSource.description: Where the marketIcon value came from (publisher bookkeeping).

category.description: Primary category slug (single value — decides the category drawer; lowercase `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`, shape-checked only, no whitelist: unregistered slugs are legal and file under the Other bucket). Copied from plugin.json `category` by publish when declared.

categories.description: Secondary category slugs (tags) — feed search and sub-category chips; never duplicated into the drawer (primary is `category` alone). Shape-checked only, no whitelist.

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL of the latest .linkdesk-plugin asset (the GitHub Release asset).

size.description: Asset size in bytes (shown in the marketplace UI).

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the latest publish.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum host (app) version this plugin accepts — the marketplace uses it to refuse installs on older hosts (pool-supplied plugins must declare it). Mirrors plugin.json `minAppVersion`.

readmeUrl.description: Remote raw URL of the repository README.md — the 'Details' tab of an uninstalled plugin renders this. Written automatically by publish when a README.md exists at the project root (same tag as the zip ⇒ what you see uninstalled equals what you get installed). No README.md ⇒ field omitted.

items.description: Positions after the first are images only — the video slot is index 0 by design.

screenshots.description: Gallery media. `string` = image URL (legacy entries keep working unchanged). At most ONE video item and it must be the FIRST item (cover video): `{"type":"video","url":…,"poster":…}`. Extra/mispositioned videos are dropped at parse time with a declaration warning (never silently turned into images). Playback mirrors the README video contract: controls forced, preload=metadata, autoplay stripped, poster preferred; no hosting — the author's direct link only.

license.description: License declared by the author (display field on the detail page).

repository.description: The plugin's own homepage URL as explicitly declared by the author — the only exit for non-GitHub hosting / CDN / own-site projects. Omitted → derived from downloadUrl/readmeUrl when possible; undeducible → the detail page omits the row.

pricing.description: Marketplace-Store v2 pricing declaration — display only, never an arbiter: LinkDesk collects no money; the purchase flow opens the author's sale page in the browser and license verification happens offline in the shell (Ed25519).

versions.description: Version history, NEWEST FIRST — the update mechanism's data source. The publisher appends; do not reorder by hand.

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL of this version's asset.

changelog.description: Release notes for this version (sliced from the repository CHANGELOG.md's matching section at publish time; rendered in the uninstalled 'Changelog' tab).

url.description: Direct video URL (author-hosted; the store never re-hosts).

poster.description: Cover frame shown before playback; preferred over the first video frame.

model.description: "paid" = one-time purchase + license key (v1 mainline); "subscription" = reserved enum slot (serverless renewal checks are a B3 topic — declaring it today just renders the badge, nothing verifies it).

price.description: Display price; currency semantics belong to the author's sale page.

period.description: Billing period for subscription display (e.g. monthly/yearly).

licenseUrl.description: Author's sale page — the buy flow opens this in the external browser (shell openExternal gate). Required when model is "paid".

refundUrl.description: Refund policy page (refunds are the author's channel's responsibility; the store only displays the link).

trialDays.description: Trial length shown as static copy. The actual trial gate lives in the author's plugin code — the shell does not enforce it.

channel.description: Reserved for the B3 dual-track: "self" = author sells with offline-signed licenses (0% cut), "managed" = hosted licensing/payments on our side. Pure enum slot in v1 — no behavior attached.

url.description: The source repo (or raw marketplace.json) URL — what the store merges.

authorId.description: Author identity the endorsement belongs to (aggregation key into the author domain).

id.description: Stable id (reference/dedup key — author store sections reference it).

title.description: Shown as-is (author data, no t() pipeline).

hint.description: Section sub-caption under the title — declared ⇒ rendered, undeclared ⇒ nothing (renderers never invent copy).

layout.description: Collection shape → card variant mapping (banner→hero, strip→small row, duo→large pair, grid→medium grid). One prototype per collection — no per-card mixing.

items.description: Member pluginIds in display order; missing ids are skipped silently.

glow.description: Ambient glow switch for this collection wherever it renders — the store honors it at both levels (section-level and collection-level; R4-3.9/08 §三·v3.57 U4). Default on (glow color follows the cover art — part of the design language, not authorable); false → neutral shadow fallback.

more.description: Optional jump link on the collection heading — declared ⇒ rendered, undeclared ⇒ no link (renderers never auto-add "More"). Same closed target set as homepage sections.

order.description: Category slug display order. Unregistered slugs land in the Other bucket (rail hides empty entries; the rail itself stays the full registry).

icons.description: slug → icon (lucide name or bundled asset); optional per-slug.

authorBlock.title: Author block (authors/<authorId>.json)
authorBlock.description: The v2 author-block file living at `authors/<authorId>.json` inside a marketplace source root. One file per authorId; the same id placed in every repo of a multi-repo author is what aggregates them into one author domain (decentralized — no central registry). authorId canon: the author's GitHub username (avatar/name/intro come from GitHub; the local fields below are the non-GitHub fallback). Catalog operators may host author blocks too. Bad JSON / missing authorId → the whole block is skipped (fatal); non-fatal issues become declaration warnings on the sources page.

$schema.description: JSON Schema $schema reference (authors.schema.json URL) — legal so the file validates against the schema it names (`marketplace-kit init` writes it; VS Code completion).

authorId.description: 🔑 Aggregation key + identity canon — recommended: the author's GitHub username. Same id across repos ⇒ one author domain; conflict resolution = user source-list order.

name.description: Display name (required here as the non-GitHub fallback; GitHub authors may still override).

avatar.description: Fallback avatar URL (GitHub canon takes precedence when resolvable).

intro.description: Author intro text (fallback chain: author intro → repo intro → render nothing).

storeTitle.description: Author store name — default "<name>'s Plugin Store"; declare to rename.

publicKey.description: Author's Ed25519 public key (base64) — the shell verifies license keys against it offline. Generated by `marketplace-kit keygen`; never hand-write one.

repos.description: Multi-repo ownership — one segment per repo (≥1). Same authorId across repos aggregates; each segment can carry its own intro/image (shown only on the in-store repo card).

sections.description: Author store-front section declarations, rendered in declared order. Omitted ⇒ the default front (category browse + all-plugins grid). "Browse by category" is renderer-hardwired and NOT declarable — it always closes the list. No limits on which/how many sections an author declares; unknown types become warnings, not crashes.

id.description: Repo segment id (referenced by `repo:<id>` jump targets).

intro.description: Repo intro — the per-repo voice of a multi-repo author (shown on the in-store repo card only).

sourceUrl.description: This repo's marketplace.json URL — what repo switching pulls.

type.description: Closed set — renderers recognize exactly these four; anything else is a declaration warning.

title.description: Section heading — fully author-owned ("Editor's picks" is as legal as anything else); never invented by the renderer.

hint.description: Section sub-caption — declared ⇒ rendered, undeclared ⇒ nothing.

glow.description: Ambient glow switch for the whole section: default on (glow color follows the cover art — part of the design language, not authorable); false → neutral shadow fallback. No custom glow color, no per-card mixing.

more.description: Optional jump link on the section heading — declared ⇒ rendered, undeclared ⇒ no link (renderers never auto-add "More").

slides.description: hero only — carousel slides; the author picks which plugins make the big screen (3–5 like the official store).

collection.description: collection only — the CollectionDecl id to render.

layout.description: collection only — card prototype for the whole section (one per section; to mix, split into two sections).

top.description: rank only — how many rows to show (computed slot; the author may omit it).

scope.description: rank only — omitted = all merged sources; "self" = only the store owner's own plugins.

plugin.description: pluginId featured on the big screen.

tag.description: Corner tag copy (author data, shown as-is).

label.description: Link copy — fully author-owned ("More", "Choose more themes", anything).

target.description: Closed set, no exceptions: `category:<slug>` (category page; in an author store it lands on the global category page pre-filtered by the author, with a persistent show-all switch), `rank` (full rank page — no store-scope variant by design), `repo:<id>` (switch repo, author stores only). No arbitrary URLs, no invented pages.

vendor.title: Vendor registry entry (vendors.json)
vendor.description: One row of the vendor registry — the `vendors.json` file at the root of the official catalog repo (array of these objects; only the catalog operator writes it; applications go through PR + CI). "Official ✓" = this entity's own official publishing, search-engine semantics — the badge decision chain is entry.authorId → registry hit ⇒ official, miss ⇒ community, local ⇒ local. Vendor display names are never used for matching (collisions legal); unregistered vendors claiming an id get no badge, and near-name matches show an honest "similar name, unverified" notice.

domains.description: Domain self-verification candidates: https://<domain>/.well-known/linkdesk-vendor.txt must contain the vendorId ("domain" tier).

githubOrgs.description: GitHub org membership verified manually ("github-org" tier).

verifiedBy.description: Certification tier: "domain" = automatic self-proof via the well-known file; "github-org" = manual org check; "manual" = operator-verified (highest trust).

verifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 date of the last verification.
